remarks:
Welcome home to this spacious 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath Colonial offering comfort, style, and plenty
of room to enjoy. Thoughtfully updated over the years, the heart of the home is the beautifully
remodeled kitchen featuring granite countertops, a cozy breakfast nook, and all appliances
included.

Hardwood floors add warmth and character throughout the home. Outside, you will appreciate the
freshly blacktopped double-wide driveway leading to a 2-car garage with a convenient tandem
rear garage door, providing easy access to the large backyard—perfect for entertaining,
gardening, or simply relaxing.

The bright and inviting great room overlooks the backyard and features expansive windows and
skylights that fill the space with natural light, making it an ideal family room, home office, or
peaceful retreat. The full basement offers excellent potential to create additional living or
entertainment space.
This well-maintained home is full of charm and possibilities. 

Come check this gem out!
